pass_criterion: Validated authoritative occurrence pathway exists
failure_action: Find alternate official source or trigger SWITCH/STOP

pass_criterion: Validated authoritative geology pathway exists
failure_action: Find alternate source, constrain boundary or SWITCH
notes: Coverage is measured later

required_measurement_or_artifact: Current fault/fold layer, taxonomy, geometry type, CRS, licence and extent
pass_criterion: Validated structures pathway exists or limitation is explicitly recorded
failure_action: Use alternate source or document non-blocking limitation
notes: Structures are required context but have no standalone numeric gate

required_measurement_or_artifact: Current grid/survey product, extent, nominal/effective resolution, nodata and access method
pass_criterion: Validated authoritative magnetic pathway exists
failure_action: Acquire alternate grid or constrain/switch boundary
notes: Coverage is measured after masking

required_measurement_or_artifact: Current grid/survey product, extent, station/survey context, resolution, nodata and access method
pass_criterion: Validated authoritative gravity pathway exists
failure_action: Acquire alternate grid or constrain/switch boundary
notes: Coverage is measured after masking

required_measurement_or_artifact: Licence, attribution, raw redistribution, derived-output and restriction classification for every source
pass_criterion: All inputs have a compliant code/manifest/derived-output publication pathway
failure_action: Restrict publication, replace source or fail candidate
notes: Unresolved material licensing risk blocks GO

required_measurement_or_artifact: Pagination, limits, count query, retries, content type and silent-truncation controls
pass_criterion: Method can retrieve all relevant records and detect incomplete acquisition
failure_action: Correct acquisition design or change source
notes: No full acquisition until design tests pass

required_measurement_or_artifact: Raw snapshot, manifest, retrieval metadata, SHA-256, working GeoParquet and reconciled row count
pass_criterion: Snapshot is independently identifiable; source counts reconcile where supported; original values are preserved
failure_action: Reacquire without truncation or switch source
notes: Raw redistribution depends on E013

required_measurement_or_artifact: Rows, valid/invalid geometries, coordinate quality, field nulls, statuses, types, commodity values and suspicious clusters
pass_criterion: All gate-relevant quality limitations are quantified
failure_action: Repair parsing, exclude unusable records or fail label-quality gate
notes: No assumptions may replace measured null/error rates

required_measurement_or_artifact: Versioned token mapping, rationale, unknown tokens and manual-review queue
pass_criterion: Every observed token is mapped, excluded or explicitly unresolved
failure_action: Review ambiguous tokens or abandon affected definition
notes: Do not guess historical abbreviations

required_measurement_or_artifact: Raw, mapped, included, excluded, unresolved and coordinate-valid counts for each definition plus coherence assessment
pass_criterion: At least one scientifically defensible definition proceeds, otherwise SWITCH/STOP
failure_action: Switch commodity/deposit-system definition or STOP
notes: Broadening labels cannot hide a failing result

required_measurement_or_artifact: Authoritative-ID, parent-child, normalised-name and projected-distance grouping rules with confidence and review triggers
pass_criterion: Method is deterministic, reversible, tested and preserves all source records
failure_action: Repair rules or require manual resolution
notes: Projected distances only

required_measurement_or_artifact: Deduplicated high-confidence canonical positive sites
pass_criterion: >=80 high-confidence sites; >=120 preferred
failure_action: Expand region or switch commodity/definition; do not lower threshold
notes: Count applies to independent sites, not raw rows

required_measurement_or_artifact: Versioned boundaries with CRS, rationale, context buffer, positive count and geological-coherence notes
pass_criterion: At least three comparable candidates where feasible; evidence explains any exception
failure_action: Add candidate, broaden/constrain region or SWITCH
notes: Do not select largest boundary automatically

required_measurement_or_artifact: Verified projected CRS, provisional 5 km cells, approximately 50 km blocks, deterministic IDs and site assignments
pass_criterion: Assignments are reproducible and boundary sensitivity is documented
failure_action: Correct CRS/grid design or test alternate origin/size
notes: Provisional identifiers are not production-ready

required_measurement_or_artifact: Percent of candidate cells intersecting a valid geology unit, by candidate and block
pass_criterion: >=95% valid geology coverage
failure_action: Repair layer, reduce boundary or switch source
notes: Record map scale and surface/interpreted status

required_measurement_or_artifact: Extent overlap, geometry validity, feature density, taxonomy and obvious gaps
pass_criterion: Coverage and limitations are measured and usable for later feature planning
failure_action: Repair/replace layer or document limitation
notes: No standalone percentage threshold in governing plan

required_measurement_or_artifact: Valid magnetic pixels after masking, by candidate and block
pass_criterion: >=90% valid magnetic coverage
failure_action: Acquire alternate grid or constrain/switch boundary
notes: Record effective resolution and survey joins

required_measurement_or_artifact: Valid gravity pixels after masking, by candidate and block
pass_criterion: >=90% valid gravity coverage
failure_action: Acquire alternate grid or constrain/switch boundary

required_measurement_or_artifact: Number of useful spatial blocks containing deduplicated positives
pass_criterion: >=8 useful positive spatial blocks
failure_action: Review block design, broaden region or switch target

required_measurement_or_artifact: Largest mine/camp cluster share and concentration pattern

failure_action: Broaden region, redesign blocks or switch target

failure_action: Correct report or withhold decision
